EditPaneDescriptionTextBlock.Text: Select cards to add to the home page, then adjust their position and size in the grid.

NoSelectedCardTextBlock.Text: Click a card on the home page to edit its position and size.

SelectCardSourcePromptTextBlock.Text: First select a card source, then fill in its parameters to add it to the home page.

NoSpaceWarning.Title: No Available Space
NoSpaceWarning.Content: There is no space in the current home page grid that can fit this card.

LayoutConflictWarning.Title: Layout Conflict
LayoutConflictWarning.Content: This position or size would extend beyond the home page grid, or overlap with other cards.

GridShrinkBlockedWarning.Title: Cannot Shrink Grid
GridShrinkBlockedWarning.Content: Cards exist in the rows or columns to be removed. Please move or delete them first.

InvalidSourceParameterWarning.Title: Incomplete Parameters
InvalidSourceParameterWarning.Content: Please fill in the User ID, Work ID, Series ID, or search keyword required by the current card source.
